native_energy_branches.energy_gate: Direct mj_energyPos clears both energy values and mj_energyVel returns when mjENBL_ENERGY is disabled; skip energy-only prerequisites in that branch.

combined_order_for_three_projections: mj_flex if potential-energy flex prerequisites are needed
mj_tendon if potential-energy tendon lengths or kinetic tendon armature are needed
mj_crb if kinetic energy is computed
mj_tendonArmature if kinetic energy is computed and its contribution is nonzero
existing_detailed_contract.energy_work_gate: mjENBL_ENERGY enabled; otherwise skip energy prerequisite stages, but preserve energyPos clearing both entries followed by energyVel no-op.
external_effect_limits: No control/passive/sensor/plugin callback is introduced by the selected stage bodies or their bounded normal math/Jacobian/wrapping routes.
No native RNG function occurs in the retained normal stage routes. Sensor noise stages are excluded.

Allocation failures and invalid model/type/wrap/interpolation invariants can enter native diagnostic handlers. The version-matched error/TLS/global-logging contract remains necessary; default logging is not side-effect-free.

Libm, SIMD intrinsics, memory helpers and compile-time macros remain explicit leaves of the lexical source record. This record is not compiled call-graph, resident-code, or whole-process effect attestation.

effects: Temporary nv-element stack allocation and scratch stack accounting.
Mass preparation timing is recorded separately; mj_energyVel itself has no timer macro.
kinetic_projection.matrix_mirror_limit: The old routines update qM directly.

existing_detailed_contract.native_state_boundary: Keep copied qpos, qvel, qacc, applied inputs, stored forces and constraints unchanged as native stored state. Completion buffers and scalar projections belong to separate scratch results. These three stages do not recompute qacc. Their prerequisite closure does not certify the separate rnePostConstraint constraint-force inputs.

conditional_preparation.condition: ntendon > 0 and native spring terms enabled
conditional_preparation.reason: The tendon loop reads ten_length; full tendon stage also computes Jacobians and wrapping data.

conditional_preparation.condition: Native spring terms enabled and a non-rigid flex with nonzero edge stiffness and dimension <= 1 exists
conditional_preparation.reason: The native flex-energy loop reads non-rigid flexedge_length entries.

potential_projection.energy_enable_behavior: If mjENBL_ENERGY is disabled, energyPos clears both energy entries and returns; energyVel returns unchanged.
potential_projection.free_joint_limit: The retained free-joint branch normalizes a copied four-element qpos slice before its translational spring term. Do not silently replace it with a hand-written corrected formula.
potential_projection.gravity_input: xipos is required when gravity is enabled; joint spring terms use qpos and qpos_spring.
potential_projection.term_limits: Preserve the source result. This function does not add arbitrary plugin potential energy or flex dimension > 1 elastic energy.

existing_detailed_contract.scope: Three completion projections and their necessary data stages; not an API inventory or provider-readiness denominator.
serial_scratch_preconditions: Separate owned mjData allocation with copied state and a stable, internally consistent compiled mjModel.
No active stack frame in the source; do not enter completion concurrently with a writer.
threadpool == 0 for the ordinary owned-stack route; the shared thread-pool stack route is outside this contract.
The separate copy/allocation, callable/image custody, and TLS/logging contracts still apply.
existing_detailed_contract.sleep_contract: These retained stage bodies do not have the later sleep-filter branches.

timer_contract.custody_requirement: A Python callback getter returning None does not prove the C pointer is null. A non-null pointer requires the separate authenticated timer effect contract. The default GetTime route has a first-call static clock-epoch effect. Do not run it merely to discover or initialize that state.
timer_contract.native_macro_effect: TM_START and TM_END call the actual mjcb_time pointer if non-null; TM_END also increments scratch timer duration and number.

native_energy_branches.general_qM_parity: The native mass routines update qM directly.
native_energy_branches.kinetic_tendon_requirement: No tendon/actuator armature term exists in these pinned mass routines.
order_for_combined_energy_subtree_projec: mj_flex when native potential-energy flex edge lengths are read
mj_tendon when spring tendon lengths or tendon mass Jacobians are required
native_energy_branches.potential_flex_requirement: When the native spring branch runs, an eligible flex has !flex_rigid, flex_edgestiffness != 0, flex_dim <= 1 and at least one !flexedge_rigid within [flex_edgeadr, flex_edgeadr+flex_edgenum). mj_flex supplies current flexedge_length; this energy function does not add arbitrary higher-dimensional/plugin elastic energy.
native_energy_branches.potential_tendon_requirement: When the native spring branch runs and ntendon > 0, prepare mj_tendon. The source reads ten_length even when tendon_stiffness is zero; do not infer an omission from zero stiffness. Modern sleep filtering is retained, but running the declared full tendon stage avoids handwritten active populations.
